title: Long QT Syndrome-Population Genetics and Cardiac Studies
brief_summary: To investigate the clinical, genetic and cardiologic aspects of the Long QT Syndrome, a predominantly hereditary disease with episodic malignant arrhythmias and sudden death, and a demonstrated gene linkage in a large pedigree.
raw_criteria: Probands are required to have clinical dx of LQTS. Family members are also invited to participate regardless of their dx.
study_population: As of the 2013 closeout report, 1329 probands with clinical dx of LQTS and members of their extended families have been enrolled in the LQTS Registry. By ECG classification, this includes 3420 probands and affected family members, 3533 unaffected family members, and 2105 family members with borderline QTc. Of those, 2125 have had mutations identified.
